example_dialogues.text_b: I am upset because I have to adjust the wheel alignment again. I always check the calibration of the alignment stand before starting but this morning I forgot and it was such a silly mistake.
I am angry because I have to refill the coolant system again. I always tighten the reservoir cap properly but this morning I forgot and the instructor marked me down.
I am tired because I have to mount all the tyres again. I always clean the rim edges before mounting but today I forgot and my feet already hurt after standing for so long.

dialogues.text_b: I am angry because I have to recheck the brake fluid level again. I always inspect the master cylinder carefully but today I forgot and the instructor marked me down.
I am tired because I have to replace the air filter again. I always clear the housing chamber properly but today I forgot and my feet already hurt after standing for so long.
I am upset because I have to clean the fuel injectors again. I always attach the nozzles correctly but today I forgot and it was such a silly mistake.
I am angry because I have to flush the engine oil again. I always warm up the engine slightly before draining but today I forgot and the instructor marked me down.
I am upset because I have to test the battery voltage again. I always connect the multimeter leads properly but today I forgot and it was such a silly mistake.
I am tired because I have to scrub the engine bay again. I always rotate duties with others, but today I got only cleaning work and my feet already hurt after standing for so long.

activity_b.text: Good morning, Imran. Nice to meet you.
Good morning, Madam.
Please relax and take a seat.
How are you today?
Quite good. I’m looking forward to talking to you about my future in the automobile field.
Great.
Let’s begin with something basic.
Tell me, what do you know about our company?
Last night I read about your company on the Internet.
I learned that you specialise in hybrid-vehicle servicing and that you recently opened a new diagnostic centre.
I also liked the way you use modern scanning tools in your workshops.
I’m glad you checked it.
Now, before we discuss your skills, tell me—what do you like most in the automobile industry?
Honestly, Madam, I like solving real mechanical problems.
When we inspect brakes, adjust engine timing, or replace filters, I can see improvement immediately.
I also enjoy working in a busy, hands-on environment.
That’s good to hear.
And what tasks are you good at?
I am good at basic engine checks and keeping the service bay organised.
During my training, I replaced spark plugs, cleaned throttle bodies, and assisted my instructor during full-service inspections.
And what technical skills do you have?
I know how to read simple wiring diagrams, check fluid levels, and use tools like torque wrenches, multimeters, and OBD scanners.
Last month, I carried out a brake-pad replacement during a workshop practical.
We sometimes use advanced diagnostic scanners.
Are you familiar with them?
I am not familiar with them yet, Madam, but I can read about them on the Internet.
That’s how I learned more about hybrid-battery maintenance.
Excellent.
Finally, why should we select you?
Because I learn fast, I work carefully, and I am always ready to support the team.
Thank you, Imran. We’ll contact you soon.
